node.title: Bloom filters
node.body: A Bloom filter is a probabilistic data structure for set membership. Bloom filters can report false positives but never false negatives.

node.title: Hash functions
node.body: Hash functions map keys to buckets. Good hash functions spread keys evenly; hashing is used by hash tables and Bloom filters.

node.title: Hash tables
node.body: A hash table stores key-value pairs in buckets chosen by a hash function. Collisions are resolved by chaining or open addressing.

node.title: Open addressing
node.body: Open addressing resolves collisions by probing other buckets: linear probing, quadratic probing or double hashing.

nodes.body: B-trees are balanced trees with many keys per node, used by databases and file systems for indexing on disk.

nodes.body: An index speeds up queries. Databases use B-trees or hash indexes; indexing trades write speed for read speed.
